text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Gamuda Cove) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 6 September 2019.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Gamuda Cove yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan

Hubungan Tengah yang bermula dari kilometer 26.142 di koordinat U 319124.995,

T 403177.718 Grid Bentuk Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000)

dan berakhir di kilometer 27.139 di koordinat U 318415.972, T 403867.692 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan Hubungan Tengah, kedua-dua

jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan Hubungan Tengah

di Persimpangan Bertingkat Johor Bahru termasuk Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar

Bandar Gamuda Cove dan jalan-jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di Had Sempadan

Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat U 319646.112, T 402715.690 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BANDAR GAMUDA COVE INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Bandar Gamuda Cove

Interchange) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 6 September 2019.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Bandar Gamuda Cove Interchange

which is part of the North South Expressway Central Link commencing from

kilometre 26.142 at coordinates N 319124.995, E 403177.718 of the Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 27.139

at coordinates N 318415.972, E 403867.692 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

of the North South Expressway Central Link, both distances are measured from

kilometre 0.0 of the North South Expressway Central Link at the Johore Bahru

Interchange including the Bandar Gamuda Cove Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link

roads and ending at the Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR)

at coordinates N 319646.112, E 402715.690 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Schedule.
